description: This Java class 'SignalMapperFactory' serves as a factory for creating instances of various SignalMapper classes related to different command types, such as things, policies, messages, and searches, in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: SignalMapperFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing static factory methods to instantiate various SignalMapper implementations for different command and response types within the Ditto framework.

methods.name: newThingModifySignalMapper
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ThingModifySignalMapper for handling modification commands of things.

methods.name: newThingModifyResponseSignalMapper
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ThingModifyResponseSignalMapper for handling responses to thing modification commands.

methods.name: newThingQuerySignalMapper
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ThingQuerySignalMapper for querying things.

methods.name: newThingQueryResponseSignalMapper
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ThingQueryResponseSignalMapper for handling responses to thing query commands.

methods.name: newRetrieveThingsSignalMapper
methods.description: Creates a new instance of RetrieveThingsSignalMapper for retrieving multiple things.

methods.name: newRetrieveThingsResponseSignalMapper
methods.description: Creates a new instance of RetrieveThingsResponseSignalMapper for handling responses to retrieving multiple things.

methods.name: newThingSearchSignalMapper
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ThingSearchSignalMapper for searching for things.

methods.name: newPolicyModifySignalMapper
methods.description: Creates a new instance of PolicyModifySignalMapper for modifying policies.

methods.name: newPolicyModifyResponseSignalMapper
methods.description: Creates a new instance of PolicyModifyResponseSignalMapper for responses to policy modification.

methods.name: newPolicyQuerySignalMapper
methods.description: Creates a new instance of PolicyQuerySignalMapper for querying policies.

methods.name: newPolicyQueryResponseSignalMapper
methods.description: Creates a new instance of PolicyQueryResponseSignalMapper for handling responses to policy queries.

methods.name: newMessageCommandSignalMapper
methods.description: Creates a new instance of MessageCommandSignalMapper for handling message commands.

methods.name: newMessageCommandResponseSignalMapper
methods.description: Creates a new instance of MessageCommandResponseSignalMapper for responses to message commands.
